_how_to_use: Yours to edit. The Knowledge base tab reads this file at runtime. Add a decision whenever you make a choice someone will later ask about; add a note for anything else worth remembering. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

decisions.statement: The Command Center is a static site with no build step, entered from index.html at the repo root.
decisions.rationale: GitHub Pages on a free public repo serves only the root or docs/, and docs/ is rewritten by the platform on every sync.

decisions.statement: Every tab reads the .colaberry/ files at runtime through one loader; no plan content is typed into a component.
decisions.rationale: The files are rewritten on each sync, so a typed-out copy would silently go stale.

decisions.statement: The Knowledge base question panel answers from page data by fixed rules, with no AI model behind it.
decisions.rationale: A public static page cannot hold an API key. Rules can cite their source tab and say plainly when they cannot answer.

decisions.statement: A .nojekyll file sits at the repo root.
decisions.rationale: Without it GitHub Pages skips dot-folders, so .colaberry/ would not be served and the hosted page would load no data.

decisions.statement: Real is the default mode; Sample must be switched on and is bannered on every screen.
decisions.rationale: Nobody should demo sample data by accident.

decisions.statement: The AI agents tab lists story owners, labelled as owners, while plan.agents is empty.
decisions.rationale: The plan carries no scoped agent roster yet; presenting a job title as an AI agent would overstate the design.
